name: model-router
description: Cut usage by sending each sub-agent task to the cheapest model that can do it well: the smallest model for searching and reading, the standard one for routine work, the strongest only for hard or risky work.

interface.shortDescription: Cheapest model that can do each sub-agent task
interface.longDescription: Tells Codex to set a model and reasoning effort on each sub-agent by task difficulty, so searching and reading stay cheap and the strongest model is kept for hard or risky work.
